title: Ignatius Gallaher
html_source: Appears as a character in “A Little Cloud,” ‘Dubliners’. In Aeolus he is identified as an employee of the Irish-born English publisher Alfred C. Harmsworth on either the ‘London Daily Mail’ or the ‘London Evening News’. A notable story is told about Gallaher in Aeolus.
